title.zh: ChatGPT Sites：用对话创建并发布网站
title.en: ChatGPT Sites: Build and Publish Websites

excerpt.zh: ChatGPT Sites让用户通过自然语言创建、测试和发布网站或应用，但功能仍处于公测阶段，访问权限、用量和工作区控制因计划与地区而异。
excerpt.en: ChatGPT Sites lets people create, test, and publish websites or apps through natural language, but its public beta still has plan-, region-, and workspace-dependent limits.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: ChatGPT Sites把想法变成可发布的网站
text.en: ChatGPT Sites Turns Ideas into Publishable Websites

text.zh: ChatGPT Sites是OpenAI推出的对话式建站功能。用户可以用自然语言描述想做的网站、应用或游戏，也可以添加文件、视觉参考，或从现有的Codex项目开始；ChatGPT随后协助生成内容和功能。
text.en: ChatGPT Sites is OpenAI's conversational tool for building websites. Users can describe a website, app, or game in natural language, add files or visual references, or start from a compatible Codex project while ChatGPT helps shape the result.

text.zh: 工作流程覆盖创建、预览、修改和发布。网站会在应用内浏览器中提前打开，用户可以要求调整布局、内容或功能，再选择访问范围。发布后仍可继续更新，工作区所有者还可以邀请同一工作区的成员共同编辑。
text.en: The workflow covers creation, previewing, revision, and publishing. A site opens in ChatGPT's in-app browser for testing before publication, allowing users to request changes to layout, content, or features. Owners can keep updating it and invite active members of the same workspace to edit.

text.zh: ChatGPT Sites支持权限、存储与连接工具
text.en: ChatGPT Sites Adds Access Controls, Storage, and Tool Connections

text.zh: 网站可以只对创建者和工作区管理员开放，也可以分享给指定人员、整个工作区或公众。通过“Sign in with ChatGPT”，访客能够保存进度；内置存储还可保存信息以及上传的文档和图片。用户也能重命名托管网址，或连接自己的自定义域名。
text.en: A site can remain limited to its creator and workspace administrators, or be shared with selected people, a workspace, or the public. With “Sign in with ChatGPT,” visitors can save progress, while built-in storage can retain information and uploaded documents or images. Users can also rename the hosted address or connect a custom domain.

text.zh: ChatGPT Sites的限制仍决定实际可用性
text.en: ChatGPT Sites Still Depends on Access and Permission Limits

text.zh: 这项功能目前处于公测，仅向符合条件的Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise和Edu计划开放，具体可用性、使用上限和工作区设置取决于计划与地区。符合条件的Business和Enterprise工作区可让访客授权网站读取其已连接工具中的信息，但只能读取该访客本来就有权限查看的内容，不能使用创建者的连接或修改外部工具。
text.en: The feature is currently in public beta for eligible Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu plans. Availability, usage limits, and workspace controls vary by plan and region. In eligible Business and Enterprise workspaces, visitors may authorize a site to read information from their connected tools, but only information they already have permission to access; the site cannot use the creator's connections or modify those tools.

text.zh: 因此，ChatGPT Sites的价值在于缩短从构想到可分享原型的路径，而不是消除产品开发中的所有治理问题。外部访客邀请仍在部分计划中逐步推出，可能需要批准；此外，访客连接工具的数据只在使用网站时可用，不会提供给后台运行的定时任务。团队在公开发布前仍需核对权限、数据保存方式和计划限制。
text.en: ChatGPT Sites may shorten the path from an idea to a shareable prototype, but it does not remove the governance questions of product development. External viewer invitations are rolling out on eligible plans and may require approval. Data from a visitor's connected tools is available only while that person uses the site and is not available to scheduled background tasks, so teams should verify permissions, data retention, and plan limits before publishing.
